import click


def test_wrap_text_preserves_indent_of_first_line_in_indented_paragraph():
    text = "  hello world"
    result = click.wrap_text(text, preserve_paragraphs=True)

def test_wrap_text_indented_paragraph_all_lines_indented():
    text = "Intro paragraph.\n\n    aaa bbb ccc ddd"
    result = click.wrap_text(text, width=12, preserve_paragraphs=True)
    lines = result.split("\n\n")[1].splitlines()
    assert lines[0].startswith("    aaa")
    for line in lines:
        assert line.startswith("    ")
